headline: Shutdown of Peer-Facing Interfaces and CLI Syntax Error
executive_summary: The configuration change shut down interfaces GigabitEthernet2, GigabitEthernet3, and GigabitEthernet4 on R2. GigabitEthernet2 and GigabitEthernet4 are connected to neighboring routers R1 and R3. Additionally, a CLI syntax error was detected in the device logs during the change execution.
technical_summary: Interfaces GigabitEthernet2, GigabitEthernet3, and GigabitEthernet4 were administratively shut down. GigabitEthernet2 is the link to internal peer R1, and GigabitEthernet4 is the link to lateral peer R3. A console error '% Invalid input detected' was observed in the logs.
risk_reason: Administrative shutdown of interfaces connected to active neighbors R1 and R3, combined with an unexplained CLI syntax error in the execution logs.
potential_impact: Disruption of physical and logical connectivity to neighboring routers R1 and R3, preventing any future routing or traffic exchange over these links.
recommended_action: Investigate the CLI syntax error in the logs and confirm if the shutdown of peer-facing interfaces R1 and R3 was planned and authorized.
rollback_recommendation: To roll back, enter configuration mode and apply 'no shutdown' to interfaces GigabitEthernet2, GigabitEthernet3, and GigabitEthernet4.
anomalies: CLI execution error: '% Invalid input detected at '^' marker.'
